description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class `DatatableNotFoundException` used within the Apache Fineract project. The class extends `AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException` and provides multiple constructors for handling cases where a datatable resource is not found.

classes.name: DatatableNotFoundException
classes.description: A RuntimeException indicating that a datatable resource was not found. Provides constructors to specify the datatable name, ID, or both, facilitating detailed error messages.

methods.name: DatatableNotFoundException(String datatable, Long id)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception with a message indicating a specific datatable and ID was not not found.

methods.name: DatatableNotFoundException(String datatable)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception with a message indicating a datatable was not found.

methods.name: DatatableNotFoundException(EntityTables entityTable, Long id)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception for an entity table and ID by delegating to the first constructor.

methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception for an entity table by delegating to the second constructor.
